intro: Darkshire, formerly known as Grand Hamlet, is a battered settlement in eastern Duskwood. Cloaked in an enduring, unnatural gloom and neglected by Stormwind, the town survives only through the vigilance of the Night Watch and the stubborn endurance of its people.

p: Once a peaceful woodland settlement called Grand Hamlet, the village was razed by the Old Horde during the First War and later rebuilt. Its fortune turned truly bitter following the fall of Medivh at Karazhan, whose lingering death throes cursed the surrounding woods into the shadowy wilderness of Duskwood. Despite being a nominal holding of the Kingdom of Stormwind, the town hall receives virtually no aid from the crown. Political paralysis in Stormwind City has left the garrison unstaffed and the borders unpatrolled, forcing Mayor Ello Ebonlocke and the local council to administer their own harsh, insular justice in the shadows.

Surrounded by walking dead from the western graveyards and feral worgen hunting through the woods, Darkshire clings to life along its palisades. The town's primary shield is the Night Watch, a voluntary civilian militia commanded by Althea Ebonlocke. Operating out of the town square and patrolling the pitch-black thoroughfares, these weary sentries keep the town's roads open and turn back the terrors prowling the tree line. Travelers arriving at the Scarlet Raven Tavern find the locals suspicious, frightened, and desperate for any mercenary capable of holding a blade.
